text:
Sasha: Quick update — I uploaded the final performance review form package and the manager guidance PDF to Drive. Need all managers to ACK by EOD Mon 04/15 so we can lock the review window.
Maya: link? where is it exactly?
Sasha: /drive/PeopleOps/2026-perf-cycle/Manager_Pack_v3.pdf and /drive/PeopleOps/2026-perf-cycle/ReviewForm_v2.docx
Kyle: got it, will skim. Is there a short checklist for what to attach with each review? last time some managers missed evidence.
Sasha: yes — there's a 1-page checklist in the pack. TL;DR: 1) completed review form, 2) 3-5 examples of work + dates, 3) upward feedback summary (optional), 4) suggested calibration bucket + rationale.
Jen: if a manager is OOO during the window (e.g., on parental leave), what's the process? we have a couple of exceptions this quarter.
Sasha: good q — escalation path in pack (excerpt): If manager unavailable >72h, People Ops assigns an interim reviewer (usually the director or skip-level) to fill in manager section with available evidence. Notify hr@redwood immediately.
Maya: can we get a template sentence for the interim reviewer note? keeps things consistent in calibration.
Sasha: included. sample: "Interim reviewer note: Manager on approved leave; this review compiled from shared docs, PRs, and peer feedback collected between MM/DD and MM/DD. Rating recommended: X." Use exact wording.
Kyle: what about disagreement after calibration? manager and IC can disagree with final bucket? what's next?
Sasha: escalation flow: 1) manager raise concern to People Ops w/in 5 business days; 2) People Ops mediates w/ calibration owners; 3) if still unresolved, appeal to VP People Ops whose decision is final. Timeline and form in the pack: Appeal_Form_v1 (single-page).
Jen: any changes to the rating scale or new definitions? don't want confusion during calibration.
Sasha: small tweak to "Exceeds" definition — clarified on p.4. Also added examples of evidence by role (Eng/Product/Design).
HR-bot: Reminder: ReviewForm_v2.docx is required for all non-intern ICs. Missing forms will trigger an auto-reminder 48h before window closes. :bell:
Kyle: I'll ACK once I've scheduled time with my managers to complete these. Also adding calendar blocking for review work.
Maya: thank you. can we get a list of people with missing attachments 24h before close? helps us chase.
Sasha: yes — People Ops will publish a daily missing-attachments report at 9am starting 04/12. We'll post in #people-ops-ops and DM managers directly.
Jen: one last thing — are we collecting calibration decks or just the final forms?
Sasha: final forms + any supplementary calibration deck slides (if your org uses them). upload location is same folder; name files like "teamname_calibdeck_v1.pdf".
Kyle: perfect. quick nit: can we add a reminder about documenting promotion-related context separately? different flow.
Sasha: done — added promo context section on the form and a link to the Promotions SOP.
Maya: ACK from me. Thanks team.
Kyle: ACK.
Jen: ACK.
